entries.name: Environmental Impact
entries.body: Compute-intensive routing must account for carbon footprint via E148 (Energy substrate).

entries.name: Accessibility
entries.body: All system interfaces must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Routing decisions must not discriminate by ability.

entries.name: Child Safety
entries.body: Enhanced protections for queries identified as originating from or about minors.

entries.name: Deployment Pipeline
entries.body: Shadow Mode → Canary → Staged Rollout → Full Production. No direct-to-production deployments.

entries.name: Rollback Protocol
entries.body: Every deployment must have a tested rollback path. Rollback time target: < 5 minutes.

entries.name: Monitoring & Alerting
entries.body: 24/7 monitoring with automated alerting for constitutional violations, performance degradation, and security events.
